dynamicInterpretation.F: local authority, policy, ledger, schema, freeze or verifier invalid
dynamicInterpretation.NF: local harness valid while M0-A13 T or a live multi-cycle chain is absent
dynamicInterpretation.NT: cycle, revocation or governance evidence exists but continuity, thresholds, non-weakening drift control or certificate closure is incomplete
dynamicInterpretation.T: M0-A13 is T and at least three real cycles form one exact bounded chain with effective revocation and no prohibited governance drift
